messages.subject: For Stefan Kratochwill | Infrastructure growth, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear STRABAG Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stefan Kratochwill, Chief Executive Officer.

STRABAG's growth across infrastructure and international construction markets requires disciplined alignment across governments, clients, communities and sustainability priorities. That environment aligns closely with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support STRABAG's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to STRABAG.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
